turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently do not ship internationally outside of the United States and select regions in Canada.

Here is how it breaks down:

Where we ship

Contiguous United States: All products are eligible to ship.
Alaska & Hawaii: Select products only.
Canada: Select items to limited regions, seasonally.
All other countries: We do not offer shipping.

Customs, duties, and taxes for Canada

Canadian prices are listed in CAD.
All duties and taxes are already included in the listed price on our site, so there are no extra customs fees charged at delivery.

If you are outside the US and Canada but want to ship to a US address, you can checkout using that US shipping address. If your international billing address causes issues at checkout, please reach out to our Customer Care Team at (800) 820-0465, Monday–Friday 6:00AM – 4:00PM, and Saturday 8:00AM – 4:00PM PST, and they can help you complete the order.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping is a bit different with us because you choose your timeframe instead of us auto-shipping right away.

Here’s how it works:

Order processing & shipping speed

We use standard ground shipping only; we do not offer express or same-day shipping.
Orders are typically processed within about 3 business days.
Transit time then depends on your location, which is why we show you date options at checkout instead of a fixed “X days” estimate.

Choosing your delivery timing (US)

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar and can pick an estimated arrival date that works for you.
Those dates already factor in our processing time plus standard carrier transit time to your address.
Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees, since carriers can have delays.

If you are in Canada

You select a ship week instead of a specific day.
Orders are prepared and leave our nursery that week, then go through customs and ship via FedEx 2-day from the border.
The tracking link becomes active once the package is scanned at the border.

If you tell me your country or region (US state or Canadian province), I can explain more specifically what to expect for your area.

turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

Here’s our general return and refund policy:

Live plants
We do not accept returns on live plants.
Roses are covered by a 1-year guarantee from the ship date.
Perennials are covered by a 90-day guarantee from the ship date.
Bulbs are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.
If a claim is approved, store credit is issued for the current retail value of the plant.
Gardening tools and hard goods
These may be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are new and unused.
Opened or used merchandise is not eligible for return, except gloves.
